title: EDM NARRATIVE Domain (v0.9 DRAFT)
description: What the story is and what the subject says it means (v0.8.3 core + the narrative fields of constellation and milky_way).

subject.description: Central person, object, or theme of the experience

trigger.description: What triggered or initiated the emotional response

harm.description: Emotional pain, loss, or vulnerability present in the experience

drive.description: What energized or motivated the experience

integration.description: Connection or shift between past and present understanding

summary.description: A compressed, faithful account of the experience as described by the source, preserving emotional sequence, temporal markers, and stated context without interpretation

meaning.description: The explicit realization or conclusion stated by the subject

identity_link.description: A succinct expression of how the experience connects to personal identity

turning_point.description: Marks experiences the subject explicitly identifies as life-changing or trajectory-altering at time of extraction
turning_point.x_constraints: true or false; null when the subject does not say

arc.description: The story movement(s) the experience represents. A list so that a structural reading (v0.8.3 arc_type) and a trajectory reading (v0.8.3 narrative_arc) of the same memory can both be stored; order carries no meaning.
arc.x_constraints: Each item is text + codings; EDM vocab arc/v1 unites the former arc_type and narrative_arc value sets. Free text accepted.

valence_shift.description: Directional emotional change during the experience
valence_shift.x_constraints: Free text (e.g., "loss to gratitude", "fear to relief", "joy to sadness")

self_position.description: The subject's own expressed lens on themselves within the story: the position they say they occupy (e.g. "the one who holds it together", "the person who finally said no"). STATED-ONLY: recorded only when the subject says it or paraphrases it unmistakably; never assigned from the plot, the emotion or an archetype catalogue.
self_position.x_constraints: Short phrase in the subject's own terms; NULL when not stated. Replaces narrative_archetype (the Mark & Pearson 12 are not used). Optional codings: McAdams imago (open label), agency / communion, Hermans I-position; all relation=related.
